description: Fix the Tailwind CSS v4 PostCSS configuration. The project has tailwindcss@4.3.0 installed but the postcss.config.cjs still references `tailwindcss` directly as a PostCSS plugin, which broke in v4. Need to install @tailwindcss/postcss and update the postcss config. Also need to ensure the CSS directives and tailwind.config.js work with the v4 PostCSS plugin.
steps: Install @tailwindcss/postcss as a dev dependency: pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit add -D @tailwindcss/postcss
Update apps/frontend/postcss.config.cjs to use @tailwindcss/postcss instead of tailwindcss directly
Verify the frontend build passes: VITE_BACKEND_URL=https://api.syrabit.ai pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build
If the build still fails due to @tailwind directives being incompatible with v4, update apps/frontend/src/index.css to use the v4 @import syntax instead of @tailwind directives
Commit changes with message 'fix: update PostCSS config for Tailwind CSS v4 compatibility'
findings: Installed @tailwindcss/postcss@4.1.10 as devDependency. Updated postcss.config.cjs to use @tailwindcss/postcss instead of tailwindcss directly. No changes needed to index.css - the v4 PostCSS plugin is backward-compatible with @tailwind directives and the existing tailwind.config.js. Frontend build passes with VITE_BACKEND_URL set. All 602 tests pass.
